claims.text: Lewis Hamilton spun out of the Chinese Grand Prix.
Hamilton's spin cut his 12-point lead over Alonso to four points.
Kimi Raikkonen won the race and moved within seven points of Hamilton.
Hamilton started the race in pole position.
Hamilton was leading Raikkonen by more than eight seconds at one stage.
Hamilton's tires deteriorated quickly and he let Raikkonen take the lead.
Hamilton spun out onto the gravel with 25 laps to go.

Pakistani President Pervez Musharraf ordered troops to take a television station's equipment and put a popular opposition leader under house arrest.
President Pervez Musharraf suspended the constitution and dismissed the Pakistan Supreme Court's chief justice for the second time.
Musharraf declared a state of emergency and said his actions were 'for the good of Pakistan.'
The Supreme Court declared the state of emergency illegal, claiming Musharraf -- who also is Pakistan's military chief -- had no power to suspend the constitution.
Government troops came to the Pakistan Supreme Court's chief justice's office and told him the president had dismissed him from his job.
The declaration of emergency is tied to rumors the court was planning to rule against Musharraf.
Musharraf will step down as military leader before the next term begins on November 15 and has promised to hold parliamentary elections by January 15.
